youtube.title: Why Is No Plane Window Ever Square? #Shorts
youtube.description:
The killer was never hidden. You have probably touched it, and it sits next to your seat every time you fly: the airplane window. It is never square, not on any passenger jet in the world. Most people think that is style. It is not. The curve exists because people died, and today thousands of planes swell and shrink with every flight, and they hold. Full episode on the channel.

#Shorts #aviation #didyouknow #engineering #thehiddenwhy
